manifest: seven rules. seven agents enforce one each. the eighth agent, WARDEN, checks every manual order against all seven and has no override.

money.note: sizing is used for cost math only. this repository never signs a transaction.

rules.title: only what already died
rules.asks: is this coin actually on the floor of an empty curve?
rules.denies: coin is still bid, or too young to be a corpse
rules.note: deliberately says nothing about how long the coin has been silent. Silence is WARDEN's question, and a graveyard rule that demanded it would contradict max_silence_days below - nothing could ever pass both.

rules.title: count names, not candles
rules.asks: is someone manufacturing a wave on this ticker right now?
rules.denies: too few copies, copies spread over days, or one wallet spamming itself
rules.source: post 2026-08-25 (one ticker minted dozens of times in 6h) + midwife.py

rules.title: the original, never the clone
rules.asks: am i about to buy the corpse, or the copy of it?
rules.denies: target is a clone, or the original already moved
rules.source: post 2026-08-25 (takes the original, forbidden to touch what already moved)

rules.title: the sell button stays locked
rules.asks: has the position been held long enough to be allowed to close?
rules.denies: manual exit inside the lock window while the stop has not fired

rules.title: the toll is counted in real time
rules.asks: is the hour's fee bill eating the hour's profit?
rules.denies: new entries while fees paid this hour exceed half the profit made this hour
rules.source: post 2026-08-25 (pump.fun 1.25% each side, freeze rule) + paper.py

rules.title: add to winners only
rules.asks: is this position already in profit before i add to it?
rules.denies: any add to a losing position - averaging down is a desk-level ban with no override
rules.source: post 2026-08-25 (adds only to a profitable position, averaging down forbidden)

rules.title: the thesis has a clock
rules.asks: has the reason for this trade expired?
rules.denies: holding past the thesis timer because it might still work
rules.source: post 2026-08-25 (6 hour thesis timer, closes at market)

warden.title: the agent that says no
warden.asks: if i buy this, who buys it from me?

exit_liquidity.note: WARDEN's own checks. every one is about the exit, none about the upside. this is the only place the desk disagrees with itself: GRAVEYARD wants a corpse, WARDEN wants a live book.
